cohorts.LibReuseBench: 216 test tasks x 3 models x 3 arms; controls reported separately

text: Only newly generated reasoning text from response bodies/SSE deltas; exclude requests, prior reasoning echoed in history, visible answer text, and tool arguments
normalization: Unicode words and numbers, lowercase, preserve apostrophes; punctuation and whitespace ignored
repeat_metric: A word position is repeated if it belongs to a later exact n-word sequence previously seen at a non-overlapping earlier position in the same response. Count the union of repeated positions, never double-count overlaps. Do not compare different response turns.
aggregation: Sum repeated-word and reasoning-word counts across responses, then aggregate per task and cohort. Show task-level numerator/denominator separately.
limits: Record API finish_reason=length, empty final answers, and agent wall-time limits separately. No finite capped trace proves literally infinite generation.
manual_review: Inspect high-repetition and capped examples plus selected non-flagged/agent cases. Exact repetition is a proxy, not a semantic judgment that every repeated passage is unnecessary.

additional_predeclared_diagnostics.fenced_code_sensitivity: Recompute 20-word repetition after removing balanced triple-backtick code blocks from reasoning. This does not remove all unfenced code.
additional_predeclared_diagnostics.finalization_marker: Count paragraphs beginning with an intent to write/provide/produce/finalize the final answer, response, code, or solution. Flag a task if a single reasoning response has >=5 such markers and >=1000 normalized words. This is a diagnostic phrase pattern, not a semantic infinite-loop label.
additional_predeclared_diagnostics.partial_responses: Include recorded reasoning prefixes in text statistics, label partial blocks explicitly; provider-token averages retain their previously recorded usage scope. Failed requests with no captured text are unobservable.
